title: Recoil Velocity of Gun in 1D Firing

variables.\\vec{v}_{\\text{bullet}}: Muzzle velocity vector of bullet relative to ground

assumptions: Gun and bullet initially at rest
Zero horizontal external forces during explosion
validity_conditions: Bullet velocity measured in ground inertial frame
common_misuse: Using relative muzzle velocity without correcting for gun backward recoil
Forgetting the minus sign indicating backward recoil
source_provenance: HCV1 Ch 9 p. 158; UP Ch 8 p. 272
